inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Last fire drill / CO detector and fire extinguisher checks were documented on 08/10/2026. Per provider, drills and checks were completed last month but not documented.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Children were watching a movie and using their personal tablets / phones to play games during breakfast, including children under 2yo.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding instructions for a child not yet eating table food were last reviewed / signed by parent on 08/18/2026. Feeding instructions for another child not yet table food were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Four out of the four staff files reviewed are missing safety and health related trainings including: SIDS / Shaken Baby, Abuse / Neglect, Hazardous Materials, Food Allergies, Administering Medications, Emergency Preparedness, Building and Physical Premises Safety and Communicable Diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Two caregivers were providing care for 13 children ages 9mo-12yo. Age difference between youngest and oldest child exceeded 18 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child with special needs was observed playing with scissors while partially inside a diaper changing cabinet. Two caregivers were present in the room and did not intervene until it was brought to their attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: A working carbon monoxide detector could not be located by provider during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: Infant room was relocated without prior approval from Fire Department and Child Care Regulation.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when infant classroom was relocated to its original location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Three of four files reviewed were missing the emergency-care facility address and phone number. NOTE: CORRECTED at inspection as information was added at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The most recent fire drill was conducted on 09/09/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Location of Handwashing Sink: Hand washing sink did not include soap.  Soap was added during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Location of Handwashing Sink (26 TAC §746.4405)

occurrences.finding: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: When the Pre-k aged children and toddler children were combined. Two pre-k aged children took bingo marking chips from a shelf. The caregiver noticed and asked them to put them away.   They did not. The caregiver put the chips away however some of the chips stayed in the home center. A toddler child placed several of the chips in his mouth. The teacher nothiced and took the chips from the child's mouth
occurrences.violation_type_title: Care Requirements for Toddlers - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2501(5))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: The perimeter of the slide's access is 5 feet away from the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: There is no surfacing underneath the play structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One of four files reviewed was missing a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: One of four files was missing time card information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical information was not in the binder  in the transportation vehicle for the 15 children being transported.    NOTE: CORRECTED AT INSPECTION as emergency medical information was added to the binder and in the transportation vehicle at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: Annual health inspection has not been updated. Last inspected on 10/22/2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual fire inspection has not been updated. Last inspected on 5/2/2019.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Reviewed staff records:  3 need to update the child abuse training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Observed one caregiver supervising 7 children between the ages of 6 months to 3 years old. There was an 18 month difference between the youngest to the oldest child in the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Observed television on during snack time at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: Observed two staff supervising a group of children during naptim and there was no additional staff present or in the building at the time inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: Reviewed staff records:  3 need to update the transportation training. Expired on 10/2/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Less than 5 years experience: Reviewed directors file and management training needs to be updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Less than 5 years experience (26 TAC §746.1311(f)(1))
